a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting for the reserve to reach 8 almost certainly means we both die with empty units. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one of us to survive now. I plan to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you rather than doing it secretly. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both fail. So I suggest you operate or wait this round. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that until you have 4 too.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. If we're still here, I'll run the generator every round from now on so you can reach 4. I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
